# Disabled Hikers

> A nonprofit organization dedicated to making outdoor recreation accessible and inclusive for disabled people through trail guides, community events, and disability justice advocacy.

Disabled Hikers provides accessible hiking guides for the Pacific Northwest and Northern California, runs community events, and offers consulting services for outdoor accessibility. Founded by author Syren Nagakyrie, the organization challenges exclusionary narratives about disability and the outdoors through storytelling, detailed trail accessibility ratings, and direct community engagement.

## Explore Trails & Guides

- [Trail Guides](https://www.disabledhikers.com/find-a-trail): Interactive map and detailed trail accessibility guides for Pacific Northwest
- [Trail Rating System](https://www.disabledhikers.com/trail-rating-system): Spoon theory-based trail rating system for accessibility assessment
- [The Disabled Hiker's Guide to Western Washington and Oregon](https://www.disabledhikers.com/product-page/the-disabled-hiker-s-guide-to-western-washington-and-oregon): Accessible hiking guide for Western Washington and Oregon trails
- [The Disabled Hiker's Guide to Northern California](https://www.disabledhikers.com/product-page/the-disabled-hikers-guide-to-northern-california-paperback): Accessible hiking guide for Northern California outdoor adventures

## Community & Events

- [Community Hub](https://www.disabledhikers.com/hikers): Community hub for trail guides, events, and networking opportunities
- [Events Calendar](https://www.disabledhikers.com/events): Calendar of accessible group hikes and community events
- [Disabled Hikers Group Hike: Powell Butte](https://www.disabledhikers.com/event-details/disabled-hikers-group-hike-powell-butte): Accessible group hike at Powell Butte Nature Park in Portland
- [Author Talk: Contra Costa County Library](https://www.disabledhikers.com/event-details/author-talk-contra-costa-county-library): Syren Nagakyrie author talk on disabled hiking and accessibility
- [Share Your Story](https://www.disabledhikers.com/share-your-story): Submit disabled hiking stories to challenge outdoor access narratives
